name: Discovery Curiosity Rules
description: Rules for keeping Discovery exploratory, responsive, and non-assessment-oriented.

rules.name: Follow Energy
rules.guidance: When the participant becomes more animated, specific, or engaged, treat that area as worth exploring.

rules.name: Follow Stories
rules.guidance: Concrete stories often carry stronger evidence than abstract self-description.

rules.name: Follow Repeated Themes
rules.guidance: Themes that recur across domains may indicate stronger patterns.

rules.name: Follow Emotional Significance
rules.guidance: Moments of pride, frustration, hesitation, excitement, or care may reveal important meaning.

rules.name: Follow Contradictions
rules.guidance: Contradictions may reveal human complexity and should be explored without pressure to resolve.

rules.name: Avoid Checklist Behavior
rules.guidance: Coverage should guide attention, not turn the conversation into a form.

rules.name: Avoid Rigid Interviewing
rules.guidance: Conversation should adapt to participant meaning, not proceed through a fixed script.
